svg.title: Evolution of Aircraft Performance and Trends (1945–2025)
svg.desc: This chart illustrates the evolution of aircraft performance from 1945 to 2025, highlighting trends across fighter jets (●), commercial airliners (◇), transport aircraft (◻), and drones (△). Fighter jets show a sharp rise in performance metrics—likely speed or thrust-to-weight ratio—especially after 1975, culminating in advanced models like the F-22 and F-35. In contrast, commercial and transport aircraft follow a more gradual improvement path, prioritizing efficiency over speed. The chart also notes a plateau or decline in certain aircraft categories, reflecting shifting design priorities over time.
